references.text: Describes the conquest of Lachish using the same language about striking the city with the sword and devoting all souls in it to destruction
The conquest of Eglon is mentioned directly as a basis for comparison with the destruction of Hebron
The same pattern of conquest and total destruction of Makkedah, with strikes by the sword and the devotion of all souls
Joshua destroys the Anakites from Hebron and Debir, the same area conquered in this verse
God's command to devote (חרם) the peoples of the promised land to destruction, as is carried out here
The law of total destruction of Canaanite cities, which Joshua follows in the conquest of Hebron
Caleb receives Hebron as an inheritance and drives out the three sons of Anak from there
Caleb takes Hebron and strikes down the three sons of Anak, the same city conquered here
